verdict.rationale: PostHog's CDP/pipeline system (Hog functions) lets users configure destinations that fire automatically on events, with filtering/reshaping as data is ingested, plus alerting and workflow automation for user-facing actions — directly matching 'rules that trigger actions on events'. First-party docs are detailed (posthog-docs-10/18/28, posthog-gh-7, posthog-docs-3/25) but there's no independent/hands-on validation of this specific automation-rules capability. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CDP/workflow rule triggers, and more detail on conditional rule logic beyond basic filtering.
